description: DEV-4500 — propose a new hourly rate for an active OpenTrain contract (payments.contracts.propose_rate, POST /contracts/{contractId}/compensation). Goes through the SAME worker-consent flow as the web app: records a PENDING compensation change with the existing audit trail, notifies the worker, and the worker accepts or appeals. The contract rate never changes here — only on the worker’s acceptance; existing milestones stay at the current rate. The contract rate at hire defaults to the applicant’s bid unless you pass rateUsd on the hire; a rate different from the bid needs the worker’s acceptance and is never written silently. Requires payments:write plus employer access to the contract (owner or job access; denials are non-enumerating 404s). Hourly (PAY_PER_HOUR) contracts only.

idempotencyKey.description: Request-bound idempotency key (8-128 chars); same key + payload converges.

rateUsd.description: Proposed rate in USD per hour (1–1000, at most 2 decimals).

reason.description: Optional note the worker sees with the proposal.

name: opentrain_propose_contract_rate
